purpose: Machine-readable, evidence-labelled projection of the player journey. It is an orientation and patch-bundling surface, never target authority by itself.

nodes.label: Role list / select existing role
nodes.contract: C2G_GAME_LOGIN_REQUEST {roleID}; G2R_GAME_LOGIN_REQUEST adds gateway player index/account/queue

nodes.label: Center resolves role and GS admission
nodes.contract: G2R_GAME_LOGIN_REQUEST; exact Center decision branches are not recovered

nodes.label: Materialize player / resolve base scene
nodes.contract: OnPlayerLoginRequest -> NewPlayer/LoadBaseInfo; base scene uses CurrentPos map/copy

nodes.label: Relay entry contract strip
nodes.contract: Outbound entry messages must use target enum IDs, exact packed payloads, and roleID/gatewayIndex ownership
evidence: session-019f9540 (841bbc build window): runtime packet/target DWARF investigation

nodes.label: Gateway receives permit / endpoint
nodes.contract: R2G_GAME_LOGIN_RESPOND carries nPlayerIndex, code, roleID, queueID, IP, port, GUID; success/failure codes branch here

nodes.label: Client reconnects to GS
nodes.contract: TCP :3113 then security key / first encrypted frame; protocol body remains undecoded

nodes.label: GS security + first decoded C2S
nodes.contract: AcceptSecurity/ConnectSecurity and chosen decode helper; KSG loop mismatch was rejected

nodes.label: Apply enter-scene; request account + role data
nodes.contract: OnApplyEnterScene state 5: account request ID 58 then role-data request; moves to gsWaitForRoleData=3

nodes.label: Load account / role stream
nodes.contract: account response ID64; role header fixed 14 bytes; role blocks {type,version,length}=12 bytes

nodes.label: Section ACK and ext-data completion
nodes.contract: S2C section request ID153 size3; C2S response ID4 size6; final ACK sets ext-data complete

nodes.label: Ready / initial sync
nodes.contract: C2S confirm-ready ID2 size6; requires ext-data + gsWaitForSyncClientData then gsPlaying

edges.success: Gateway forwards selected role to Center
Center sends role-login envelope to GS
GS creates player and accepts base scene
GS emits entry side effects with target Relay contracts
Center/Gateway issue client permit and endpoint

edges.failure: client remains at Gateway UI fallback

edges.success: security key then valid decoded first packet
ext-data done then ready ACK -> gsPlaying
